source.text:
Schedule 3 No Shooting or Hunting Areas (Section 4)
Okanagan Connector Highway
38 That portion of M.U.s 8-08, 3-12 and 8-06 in the Province of British Columbia contained within the following described boundaries: All areas within 0.4 km of either side of the centreline of the Coquihalla Phase III (Okanagan Connector) Highway between its junction with Highway 97 near Peachland and its junction with Highway 5 near Aspen Grove. [en. B.C. Reg. 167/88, s.1.]
